Auto-merge non-major updates. Majors stay manual.
@types/node tracks the supported Node range, so bumps are a deliberate call.
Runtime deps ship to consumers, so their bumps need a changeset. Renovate already knows the update type; label it and let renovate-changeset.yml write the matching bump.
